I answered Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message: the main contact is Thea Ramaswell, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines. She reported the duplicate arrivals on door 6 during the morning shift.

This comes from #north-team, which Marcus is in, so he can see it himself. On Aug 20, 2025, Dana said there that she would look into the problem. The cause was a driver checking in at the kiosk and then dispatch adding him again by hand.
